title: Retrieve Current AGV Fault Statistics From the WCS API
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent approved API client to retrieve current AGV fault statistics. Treat sort goods information as historical rather than as the current fault result.
when_to_use: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API in Apidog when a live diagnostic result for current AGV fault statistics is required.
not_for: Do not use historical sort information as a substitute for the current AGV fault statistics.
Do not use this procedure to assign fault severity or prescribe corrective actions; the source does not define fault meanings or corrective actions.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support performs the read-only diagnostic request using the OptiSweep / WCS API in Apidog or an equivalent approved API client.
L2_support reviews whether the returned result represents current AGV fault statistics and escalates when the request fails or does not return current statistics.
safety_notes: This procedure retrieves AGV fault statistics with the GET GetAgvFaultStats operation; no production stop or physical action is defined in the source.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the approved WCS API client on the primary server

access_required: L2_support access to the OptiSweep / WCS API
Access to Apidog or an equivalent approved API client
system_preconditions: The OptiSweep / WCS API is available to the approved API client.
